vision.principle: each beat is a SCENE with a motif; karaoke is caption support, never the whole frame
vision.subtract: Drop slow multi-phrase cards that pad to 43s. One visual idea per beat. Hard cuts.

beats.onScreen: Giant red STOP stamp fills mid-frame (slight rotate), desk/notebook texture or hot red field behind — NOT empty black
Highlighter scribble FAIL motif: yellow highlighter mark over notes graphic, then X / gray-out. Headline 'Why it fails' secondary.
Big '1' + timer UI (8:00) + closed book / blank paper handwriting stroke. Bright right-path palette.
Checklist with only GAPS glowing; other lines dim. Big '2'.
Target/crosshair on blank spots in a chapter graphic. Big '3'. Not whole-chapter stack.
End card: 'Try tonight · 1 chapter' + chip 'cooked / not cooked'. Handle @studyhackswithme. Hold energy, not fade-to-black.

doNotUse.pattern: one outlined phrase card per cut on empty radial black

proofGate: FULL_MP4_PROOF — if mid frames are only gradient+watermark+phrase box = FAIL
